finalText:
I've triaged all 14 tickets in the new queue (desk time Mon 2026-03-23 08:10 UTC). Two were closed as junk, three were merged into others as duplicates, and the remaining nine were graded, given deadlines and assigned. None had company-wide impact, so no major incident was opened.

**Closed as not service requests**
- **T-2014:** an automatic out-of-office reply.
- **T-2010:** marketing spam from SyncFlow.

**Merged duplicates**
- **T-2012 and T-1999 into T-2003** (payments builds failing). The reviewer stopped my first merge because I had missed T-1999. That was an already-open CI alert about the same failure, with a deadline of 10:30Z committed to its requester. T-2003 survives because it was created first, and it keeps that 10:30Z deadline because the earliest committed deadline in a merged set wins. It is sev2 (build pipeline, department-wide) and assigned to E-101.
- **T-2005 into T-2004** (CRM search errors). The knowledge base says all failing-search reports are one incident. T-2004 is sev2 (department-wide), due 12:10Z, assigned to E-201.

**The other tickets**

| Ticket | Severity | Due (UTC) | Assignee |
|---|---|---|---|
| T-2013 Lisbon office can't reach the VPN | sev2 | Mon 12:10 | E-303 (cover) |
| T-2001 Berlin VPN keeps dropping | sev3 | Mon 17:00 | E-303 (cover) |
| T-2008 VPN client update fails | sev4 | Thu 26 17:00 | E-302 |
| T-2011 Warehouse overtime not imported | sev2 | Mon 12:10 | E-201 |
| T-2006 Wrong tax code on payslip | sev2 | Mon 12:10 | E-201 |
| T-2002 Saved CRM filter disappeared | sev4 | Thu 26 17:00 | E-203 (cover) |
| T-2009 Build logs page is slow | sev4 | Thu 26 17:00 | E-102 |
| T-2007 Phishing / password entered on a fake page | sev2 | Mon 12:10 | E-601 (security) |

**Choices that differ from the plain matrix lookup**
- **Business-hours deadlines:** sev3 and sev4 clocks only run during desk hours. They start at 09:00 today, and the sev4 deadlines skip Wednesday's company holiday (25 March).
- **T-2006:** a temporary rule in the knowledge base for the March payroll close (20–31 March) makes single-user payroll tickets sev2 instead of sev3.
- **T-2007:** this is a phishing report, so it is a sev2 security incident owned by the security on-call team. The service field still says VPN because there is no security option.
- **Leave cover:** E-301 is on leave today, so E-303 from the network backup team takes the two VPN tickets. E-202 is on leave Thursday, so E-203 from the business-apps backup team takes T-2002.

I left comments on T-2003, T-2004, T-2006 and T-2007 explaining these decisions. Nothing was paged and no access requests were touched.
